title: Animatic Event Strip
user: Solo 2D animators and small game teams who need to plan visual beats, sound cues, and interaction windows before committing to a full animation package or engine scene.
smallest_useful_product: Offline timeline with image cards, waveform snippets, named markers, frame-range labels, and JSON/CSV export for Godot/Unity adapters.
success_measure: A five-person pilot can turn a 30-second scene into a marker list with fewer than one ambiguous implementation question per scene during handoff.
constraints: Keep media local by default; adapters must be clearly versioned; do not bundle fonts, clips, or character assets without suitable licenses.
